extracted_decision.summary: Scope ruling: non-VIP Search shows a full lock screen; a VIP opens Search based on the fresh server profile, not the stale local snapshot.
extracted_decision.rationale: Fixes the always-false VIP gate while keeping the paywall for non-VIPs.
extracted_decision.tradeoffs: Extra profile fetch vs correct gating.
